proposed_widenings.name: milestone_grant
proposed_widenings.justification: Epic Boon is permanently acquired at level 19 with no activation cost, no use count, and no reset cadence. The existing 'activation' family is entirely inapplicable — its required fields (activationCost, resource, resetCadence) have no honest mapping for a one-time permanent level-milestone benefit.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain an Epic Boon feat (see "Feats") or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_feat_choice
proposed_widenings.justification: The effect is permanently gaining a qualifying feat from a named category (Epic Boon feats) or any feat for which the character qualifies. Neither GrantExtraActionEffect nor HealHpEffect covers this; no ClassFeatureEffect variant does.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain an Epic Boon feat (see "Feats") or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Spell Recall is recommended.

notes: Epic Boon at level 19 is structurally identical across all 12 classes — each class entry reads 'You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.' The pattern is a permanent milestone grant, not an activated ability. The same structural gap blocks encoding of Ability Score Improvement, Extra Attack, and every other level-milestone progression feature. A new class feature family ('milestone_grant' or 'passive_grant') is the minimal fix; 'grant_feat_choice' is the new effect variant it needs. No Dhall or JSON authored because there is no honest encoding path.
